# 1 Clement Chapter 65 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 65 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_065_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 65

*[Final Greetings and Dispatch of the Letter-Bearers]*

**65:1** Please send our messengers back to us quickly — Claudius Ephebus, Valerius Bito, and Fortunatus — in peace and with joy. That way they can bring us word of your restored peace and harmony as soon as possible — the very thing we have been praying for and longing to see. Then we too will be able to rejoice sooner over the good order among you.

**65:2** The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you and with everyone everywhere who has been called by God through him. To him be glory and honor, power and greatness, and eternal dominion, from ages past to ages yet to come. Amen.

---

*PNEUMA renders for contemporary clarity and accessibility, capturing the spirit of Clement's pastoral appeal.*
